cases.name: Doris Morales-Ruiz
cases.about:
Morales was a loving mother, daughter, and sister that cared for her family. She lived her life to the fullest, a hard-worker who dedicated her life to making everyone around her happy.

“I’m the youngest, me and her, we were always close,” said her grieving brother, Alex Morales. “She always cared for me and I cared for her. Anything that I needed, or a family member needed, friends…if she couldn’t do it, she’d find a way.”  “She always cared for everybody,” he continued. “She was more than just a sister; I looked at her like a mom, too. She was just a great person. Good, honest, hard-working mother.”

“She always worked real hard to get her daughters through, to make sure they had all they needed. She always loved to go out places, take her girls with her…vacations and stuff,” Alex reminisced on the constant presence of Dora in the lives of her daughters. “She attended all the school activities. She was always there for them.”  “They were her number one priority.”
